policies.name: comparison_items_delete_parent_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM saved_comparisons sc
  WHERE ((sc.id = comparison_items.comparison_id) AND (sc.user_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: comparison_versions_insert_parent_owner
policies.withCheck:
((auth.uid() = created_by) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM saved_comparisons sc
  WHERE ((sc.id = comparison_versions.comparison_id) AND (sc.user_id = auth.uid())))))

views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (comparison_id) id,
    comparison_id,
    created_by,
    version_number,
    schema_version,
    snapshot,
    assumptions_hash,
    note,
    created_at
   FROM comparison_versions cv
  ORDER BY comparison_id, version_number DESC;
